events.decision: Increase form container max-width from 380px to 460px
events.rationale: On a 1440px viewport the right pane is ~720px wide; 380px fills only 53% of the column, making inputs feel pinched. 460px brings it to ~64% — comfortable without feeling stretched. No min-width is set so the form still collapses gracefully below 460px.
